text: Mary H.K. Choi's Yolk was banned from libraries and classrooms by Clay County School District in Florida in September 2022 after a formal challenge. Beaufort County School District in South Carolina banned it pending investigation in October 2022 after an informal challenge. Frisco Independent School District in Texas banned it from libraries and classrooms in November 2022. Escambia County Public Schools in Florida banned it pending investigation in December 2022 after a formal challenge, and St. John's County School District in Florida did the same in January 2023. In June 2023, Volusia County Schools in Florida banned it from libraries and classrooms.
meta_description: Yolk by Mary H.K. Choi: banned in Florida, Texas and South Carolina school districts between September 2022 and June 2023.
